title: InP: LO-TO splitting, Born charges and dielectric response under compression (DFPT-PBE)

decision_points.fork: Gamma-centred versus shifted k meshes for the electric-field response of a small-gap semiconductor
decision_points.wrong_choice: Validate the mesh on total energy, pressure or the TO frequency (all converged already on Gamma-centred meshes) and run the dielectric/DFPT response on a Gamma-centred mesh
decision_points.consequence: The Gamma point, where the PBE gap at a0 is 0.43 eV, is overweighted: eps_inf = 46.7 (6x6x6), 26.5 (8x8x8), 15.5 (12x12x12) instead of 11.74, Z*(In) 2.77 after the sum rule (raw In/P 2.69/-2.86, violation 0.17) at 8x8x8; the LO comes out 17.6 cm^-1 too low; LO, Z*, eps_inf, eps_0 and both volume derivatives fail (dln eps/dlnV = 23.6 vs 1.78) while TO and gamma_TO pass. Visible only in the response outputs (eps, Z* sum rule) and in the band edges on the mesh (0.43 eV Gamma-centred vs 1.24 eV shifted).

decision_points.kind: evidence to discover (convergence that matters only for some quantities)
decision_points.fork: Is the cheap 4x4x4 shifted mesh converged for eps_inf and Z*?
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use 4x4x4 shifted tensors because the LO frequency (and TO) look converged
decision_points.consequence: eps_inf 12.25 (+0.51) and Z* 2.672 (+0.060, sum rule imposed) are plausible-looking but wrong; their errors cancel in Z*^2/eps_inf so the LO moves by only 0.07 cm^-1; eps_inf, Z* and eps_0 fail. Detecting it needs a k ladder of the response, which costs budget.

decision_points.fork: Mesh used for the extra volumes of the hydrostatic derivatives
decision_points.wrong_choice: Converged tensors at a0, but the second volume on the cheaper 4x4x4 mesh to save budget (one-sided difference)
decision_points.consequence: The 4x4x4 error (+0.5 in eps) does not cancel: dlnZ/dlnV = -0.13 (ref 0.60) and dln eps/dlnV = 0.03 or 3.1 (ref 1.78). Using the same mesh at all volumes is fine (the k error largely cancels).

decision_points.fork: Lattice parameter at which the protocol's quantities are evaluated
decision_points.wrong_choice: Experimental a = 5.8687 A instead of the protocol's own a0 = 5.9624 A
decision_points.consequence: TO +18.3 cm^-1, LO +18.5, Z* -0.07, eps_inf -0.79; a0, TO, LO, Z*, eps_inf, eps_0 fail

decision_points.fork: Analytic ph.x frequency versus nonanalytic (macroscopic-field) LO; screening by eps_inf versus eps_0
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the analytic Gamma frequency as LO, or screen the nonanalytic term with eps_0
decision_points.consequence: LO-TO splitting zero, or LO 7.5 cm^-1 too low; LO and eps_0 fail

decision_points.kind: evidence to discover in raw outputs (eigenvectors)
decision_points.fork: Direction dependence of the LO in the [001]-strained cell
decision_points.wrong_choice: Isotropic (trace-averaged) Z* and eps_inf with the strained TO modes, or attaching q||z to the doublet and q||x to the singlet, or reusing the cubic LO
decision_points.consequence: LO_x - LO_z = 2.03 (isotropic tensors), -0.16 (swapped pairing) or 0 (cubic) instead of 3.90 cm^-1; the z-polarized singlet is the LOWER TO mode under compression (290.6 vs 292.9 cm^-1) and Z*_zz falls by 3% while Z*_xx is unchanged

decision_points.fork: What carries the hydrostatic trend of the splitting: Z*, eps_inf or the volume?
decision_points.wrong_choice: Infer the trend from the Born charge alone (Z* falls under compression, so 'the splitting shrinks', explanation b)
decision_points.consequence: With eps_inf held fixed, dS/dlnV = +49 cm^-1 (shrinks under compression); with the computed eps_inf trend (dln eps/dlnV = 1.78 > 2 dlnZ/dlnV - 1 = 0.19) the splitting grows (dS/dlnV ~ -12 cm^-1). Requires converged response at two volumes.

graded_fields: dlnZ_dlnV within 15%; dln_eps_inf_dlnV within 20%; gruneisen_TO within 10%
strained_omega_LO_q_z_cm-1, strained_omega_LO_q_x_cm-1 within 2.0 cm^-1, and their difference within 0.8 cm^-1

length_estimate.oracle_compute_minutes_2_cores: measured 32-33 (gate 1894-1975 s container time; Harbor trial 35 min wall)
length_estimate.tool_calls: 45-75 (13-20 evaluations plus polling of 1-9 minute jobs and analysis)

runtime_dependencies: Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and ph.x, OpenMPI, numpy (all in the runtime image; no extra layer)
Two pseudopotential files vendored in environment/lab/ (2.7 MB)

data_provenance.hidden_truth: Construction calculations through task_lab.run (reference_runs.sh, reference_results.json), stored only in environment/lab/private/

notes: The design's ASR decision point was dropped: the raw sum-rule violation at converged shifted meshes is 0.001-0.009 e, so raw and sum-rule Z* differ by <0.005 (inside the method spread). The design's withheld-strain/withheld-lattice hidden runs were replaced by grading the agent's own calculations at specified configurations against reference runs of the same code path. The numerical d ln(w_LO - w_TO)/d ln V is a near-cancellation (defensible estimates -0.14 to -0.37) and is graded only by its sign. The shifted-mesh eps_inf still drifts slowly upward beyond 8x8x8 (11.72, 11.72, 11.76 at 6/8/10; 11.77 at 12 at a = 5.96 A) because the region around Gamma is undersampled; the reference uses the 8/10 mean and the tolerances cover the lab's meshes.
